fortescue.author: Adrian Fortescue
fortescue.work: The Mass: A Study of the Roman Liturgy (1912)
fortescue.section: Part II, ch. V §3, The Celebrant's Preparation
fortescue.verifiedClaim: Fortescue names Psalm xlii:4 in the preparatory prayers and treats their standardization in the Missal of Pius V as distinct from the first Christian Eucharist.

introit.finding: The upstream 'qui te exspectant' does not exactly match Clementine Psalm 24's 'qui sustinent te'. Biblical citation alone is not a word-level collation. Older Latin/Itala use is a hypothesis to investigate, not a certification of this Mass.

editorialGate: Neither a digitized historical author paragraph nor an upstream chant variant is an independently verified 1962 printed-Missal witness.
